intent: Record the catalog rules a requirements patrol changed or added.
observable_outcome: get-context catalog lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A search intent the model extracted is accepted only when every filled field appears verbatim in the person's query and none is blank or over 2000 characters; a person's own correction need not quote the original query.
A search interpretation holds at most 8 keywords, each non-blank and at most 128 characters; exactly 8 keywords of 128 characters are accepted.
A search the person corrected is refused when its intent fields and keywords together exceed 2000 characters; exactly 2000 is accepted.
